title: Compactness verifies the rational derived Hom comparison
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $A=\mathcal O_E$ and $\varpi$ a uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme with $\ell$ invertible. On its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_X$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and $E_X=B_X[1/\varpi]$. Module sheaves, sheaf tensor products, derived categories and cohomology are as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Write $\mathcal C_X=D^b_c(X,A)$ for the completed integral category including compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], and $Q:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal R_X=\mathcal C_X[1/\varpi]$ for its raw rationalization [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. A rational module sheaf is constructible when on a finite locally closed stratification it is pro-etale locally finite free [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-module]. Write $F_X(K)=E_X\otimes^L_{B_X}K$ and $J_X(QK)=F_X(K)$, $J_X(f/\varpi^n)=\varpi^{-n}F_X(f)$ for the functor specified in [lem-per-rational-module-realization-functor]. For $K\in\mathcal C_X$ and every countable family $(M_i)$ in $D(B_X)$ with a common cohomological lower bound, the canonical map $\bigoplus_i\operatorname{Hom}(K,M_i[q])\to\operatorname{Hom}(K,(\bigoplus_iM_i)[q])$ is an isomorphism for every integer $q$. In particular, for $K,L\in\mathcal C_X$ the actual scalar-extension map gives natural isomorphisms
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{D(B_X)}(K,L[q])[1/\varpi]\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}_{D(E_X)}(F_XK,F_XL[q]),\qquad f/\varpi^n\longmapsto\varpi^{-n}F_X(f).$$
They commute with shifts, identities and composition. Thus $J_X$ is fully faithful into the actual ambient $D(E_X)$. The first assertion verifies, rather than assumes, the coproduct-Hom hypothesis in [lem-weil-pbc-scalar-localization-derived-hom], using the global-derived-Hom continuity of [lem-weil-pbc-integral-constructible-bounded-below-compactness].

source.place: Lemma 6.8.12 and Proposition 6.8.14(2), full faithfulness, pp. 61-62

proof.text: Choose a rational realization using lem-per-rational-module-realization-functor. Apply lem-per-completed-continuous-hom-hypotheses and its comparison field to the cofan transported by completedContinuousTransport; project the bijectivity of the completed shifted-coprojection map. This proves the first conjunct. For the generic sequential continuity predicate, reindex along ULift ℕ ≃ ℕ and check the direct-sum comparison on each generator. The same hypotheses record a lower cohomological bound for every integral object.

Apply lem-per-rational-realization-hom-transport to the given realization. Restrict its general source and target predicates to integral constructible complete objects using continuity and boundedness from step 1. Project all five fraction and coherence equations, yielding precisely ConstructibleRationalHomComparison for the chosen shift structure.

Convert degree-zero shifted Homs to ordinary Homs by the zero-shift isomorphism and identify localized modules with scalar-extended tensor Homs using Mathlib IsLocalizedModule.isBaseChange. The fraction formula at denominator one identifies this linear equivalence on every pure tensor. Conjugate by the recorded object equalities R.objects. Every tensor Hom is one fraction, by LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct and the powers-submonoid description. The canonical coefficient ring equivalence maps invSelf(varpi)^n to (varpi^n)^(-1), as follows by mapping algebraMap(varpi) * invSelf(varpi) = 1. Thus R.fractions identifies R.J.map with the resulting linear equivalence on every arrow. Its surjectivity and injectivity give Full and Faithful.

lean.statement: theorem constructibleRationalHomComparison : (∀ (K : PbcBoundedConstructibleComplete X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) (I : Type (u + 1)) [Countable I] (M : I → PbcCompletedDerived X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)), (∃ n : ℤ, ∀ i : I, (M i).IsGE n) → ∀ (q : ℤ) (s : Cofan M), IsColimit s → Function.Bijective (DirectSum.toModule (PbcIntegralRing l E) I (K.obj ⟶ s.pt⟦q⟧) (fun i : I ↦ Linear.rightComp (PbcIntegralRing l E) K.obj ((shiftFunctor (PbcCompletedDerived X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) q).map (s.inj i))))) ∧ ∀ R : RationalModuleRealization l E X, ConstructibleRationalHomComparison l E X R ∧ R.J.Full ∧ R.J.Faithful
lean.note: The first conjunct verifies the actual shifted-coprojection map for every small countable family, including the empty family. The second specializes the published scalarLocalizationHomComparison predicate, retaining all fraction, naturality, identity, composition and simultaneous-shift equations, and asserts full faithfulness of the normalized realization into the actual ambient rational-coefficient derived category. The auxiliary linear structure restricts the realization field action along the existing canonical coefficient ring equivalence.
